title: ExecutionBudget
description: Core-issued immutable execution limits. Workers apply them; Workers must not raise them or treat extra payload fields as budget authority. A value of 0 means no remaining/no granted use for that allowance. 0 never means unlimited.

budget_id.description: Opaque id of the issued budget. Not a secret. Not PostgreSQL UUID.

max_requests.description: Maximum requests allowed. 0 means no requests may be made. 0 is not unlimited.

max_tool_calls.description: Maximum tool calls allowed. 0 means no tool calls may be made. 0 is not unlimited.

max_runtime_ms.description: Maximum runtime in milliseconds. 0 means execution must not start / is immediately exhausted. 0 is not unlimited.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrency. 0 means no execution slot. 0 is not unlimited.
